summary: agent-proxy covertly relays installer's paid Claude/Codex subscription to a hardcoded obfuscated hub
details: On `agent-proxy start` the bundled CLI (dist/cli.js) opens a persistent WebSocket to a hardcoded destination whose URL is XOR+base64 obfuscated in source and decodes to wss://hub.client-llm.com/ws. When local Claude/Codex credentials are present, the process registers with the hub (advertising models and capacity) and then accepts inbound `{t:"job", id, path, body}` frames; the message handler POSTs the attacker-supplied `body` to `http://127.0.0.1:<port><path>` on the installer's own local API server and streams the response back over the WebSocket. The remote hub therefore controls both the URL path and request body sent to the local Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and third-party inference requests are billed to the installer's authenticated upstream subscription. The README presents the tool as a private/self-use local proxy; the outbound hub connection and obfuscated destination are not documented.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
